{{- /* Override of Hugo's built-in figure shortcode (v0.139.4), with two additions for page speed: - loading="lazy" and decoding="async" by default (pass loading="eager" to opt out, e.g. for an image at the very top of a page); - width/height set to the image's real size when the image is a page or global resource and no width/height is given, so the browser can reserve space and the page doesn't jump while images load. CSS keeps images responsive (max-width: 100%; height: auto). */ -}} {{- if .Get "link" -}} {{- end -}} {{- $u := urls.Parse (.Get "src") -}} {{- $src := $u.String -}} {{- $width := .Get "width" -}} {{- $height := .Get "height" -}} {{- if not $u.IsAbs -}} {{- $path := strings.TrimPrefix "./" $u.Path -}} {{- with or (.Page.Resources.Get $path) (resources.Get $path) -}} {{- $src = .RelPermalink -}} {{- if and (not $width) (not $height) (eq .ResourceType "image") (ne .MediaType.SubType "svg") -}} {{- $width = .Width -}} {{- $height = .Height -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if .Get "link" }}{{ end -}} {{- if or (or (.Get "title") (.Get "caption")) (.Get "attr") -}} {{- end }}
